args.summary: Over the telemetry window (2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12), 12 pattern-detector insights surfaced across 7 unique devices: 3 batteries now report "Service Recommended", 2 devices have critically low disk space (2–3% free), 1 device has prohibited software (uTorrent), 5 devices drifted from passing to failing the screen_lock compliance check, and 1 device shows persistent high RAM usage (≥95% in half of snapshots). Several devices have multiple concurrent issues.

claims.text: Three devices have batteries reporting "Service Recommended" since late May: acme-macbook-1 (since 2026-05-30, cycle count 1049), acme-thinkpad-8 (since 2026-05-23, cycle count 1157), and acme-dell-9 (since 2026-05-24, cycle count 948).

Two devices have critically low system-volume free space: acme-thinkpad-8 at 2.6% free (26 GB of 1024 GB), low in 25 of 30 snapshots with a trend of -0.51 percentage points/day; acme-macbook-4 at 2.0% free (10 GB of 512 GB), low in all 30 snapshots with a trend of -0.20 percentage points/day.
Prohibited software uTorrent 3.6 was first detected on acme-macbook-2 on 2026-05-31 and remains present as of 2026-06-12.

Five devices that previously passed the screen_lock compliance check are now failing consistently: acme-macbook-2 (failing since 2026-05-22, 22 consecutive fails), acme-thinkpad-8 (since 2026-05-30, 14 fails), acme-mac-5 (since 2026-06-01, 12 fails), acme-macbook-3 (since 2026-06-01, 12 fails), and acme-macbook-4 (since 2026-05-28, 16 fails).
acme-dell-9 (16 GB RAM) shows persistent high memory usage, at or above 95% in 15 of 30 daily snapshots with a maximum of 6 consecutive high-usage days.

Multiple devices have overlapping issues: acme-thinkpad-8 has battery_eol, low_storage, and compliance_drift; acme-macbook-4 has low_storage and compliance_drift; acme-dell-9 has battery_eol and ram_constrained; acme-macbook-2 has prohibited_software and compliance_drift.

caveats: Telemetry covers 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12 only; changes before or after this window are not visible.
RAM readings are one per day; high usage at that moment does not prove sustained memory pressure.
Disk trend estimates are linear fits; actual depletion may vary.
Compliance drift detector only reports checks that passed then failed; it does not capture checks that were always failing.
